newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Council to seek agreement on consumer credit law.
newsitem.headline: Council to seek agreement on consumer credit law.

text.p: The Consumer Council will seek on Monday a political agreement on a proposal to amend the EU's consumer credit directive.
The plan is for the EU to set a single mathematical formula for calculating the annual percentage rate of charge for consumer credit.
The proposal is aimed at making it easier for consumers to compare the actual cost of credit and therefore make a more informed choice about where to buy.
It will not be able to secure a final agreement as the European Parliament has not yet given its opinion.
The proposal would amend the EU's consumer credit directive 87/102.

The Council discussion will consider the number of decimal places to be used in making the calculation --- should it be one or two -- the time period for calculations -- should a 365- or 366-day year be used -- and the transposition period.
